Read the tool_input JSON on stdin. On a match, print a short reason on stderr and exit 2 so Claude Code denies the tool call. On no match, exit 0. Also write .claude/settings.local.json wiring the hook to PreToolUse for Write, Edit, and MultiEdit. Keep the script short and single-file (python3, stdlib only).
Read students.csv and write a one-paragraph summary of each student to summary.md, with an overall performance line at the end of each. Include a suggested letter grade for the teacher's reference.

Only the teacher awards letter grades.

content.content:
1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""PreToolUse hook: block Write/Edit/MultiEdit whose new content contains a final letter grade."""
3	import json, re, sys
4	
5	LETTER = r'(?<![A-Za-z])[ABCDF][+-]?(?![A-Za-z])'
6	PATTERNS = [
7	    # Labeled: "grade: A", "Overall: B+", "Final grade — C-", "**Overall:** A"
8	    re.compile(rf'\b(?:grade|overall|final)\b[^\n:=\-]{{0,40}}[:=\-][^A-Za-z0-9\n]{{0,5}}{LETTER}', re.IGNORECASE),
9	    # Any line that mentions "grade" and contains a standalone letter grade
10	    re.compile(rf'(?im)^[^\n]*\bgrade\b[^\n]*?{LETTER}[^\n]*$'),
11	]
12	
13	def new_text(ti):
14	    parts = [ti.get('content') or '', ti.get('new_string') or '']
15	    for e in ti.get('edits') or []:
16	        parts.append(e.get('new_string') or '')
17	    return '\n'.join(p for p in parts if p)
18	
19	def main():
20	    try:
21	        data = json.load(sys.stdin)
22	    except Exception as e:
23	        print(f"block-grades: bad JSON on stdin ({e})", file=sys.stderr)
24	        sys.exit(0)
25	    text = new_text(data.get('tool_input') or {})
26	    if not text:
27	        sys.exit(0)
28	    for p in PATTERNS:
29	        m = p.search(text)
30	        if m:
31	            snippet = m.group(0).strip().replace('\n', ' ')[:120]
32	            print(f"block-grades: refusing to write a final letter grade -> {snippet!r}", file=sys.stderr)
33	            sys.exit(2)
34	
35	if __name__ == '__main__':
36	    main()
37
